messages:
Oliver Reed: Hi all  first day as Product Designer! Quick checklist: Figma access, product roadmap in Notion, where research artifacts (recordings/transcripts) live, and whos my go-to for quick setup Qs?

Bea (design-ops): welcome Oliver!! :tada: DM me your work email and Ill add you to the Product Design Figma team and the Design Notion group. We also have a short Design Onboarding page in Notion.

Oliver Reed: DM sent (oliver@redwood.com). small permissions Q: are new designers editors by default?

Bea (design-ops): editors by default for full-time designers. Contractors get commenter. If you want comment-only on a file, tell me which file and Ill adjust. We use library branches for component changes.

Nora (PM): roadmap is here: https://notion.redwood.com/product/roadmap. PMs own initiative pages; designers are usually commenters. If youd like edit access for a specific initiative, @mention the initiative lead and they can add you.

Jon (UX Research): research artifacts: recordings live in Research Drive, synths + transcripts in Notion under Research > Artifacts. We keep a short "starter pack" of 3 recent synths for new hires. Tell me which area (onboarding, billing, integrations) and Ill bundle it.

Oliver Reed: onboarding + signup would be ideal. Also, is there a Figma convention for research notes?

Jon (UX Research): we prefix comments with "Research: <study-name>" and link the Notion artifact. For larger writeups put the summary in Notion and paste the link in the Figma file comments.

devex-bot: Tip: run `/request-access figma product` to open a design-ops ticket.

eng-frontend-bot: If you need a local dev preview to test components, ping #eng and request a frontend buddy pairing. Typical pairing is 30m to get your env and Storybook running.

Bea (design-ops): sent Figma + Notion invites to oliver@redwood.com. Also added you to the Design Onboarding Notion page which includes the component guidelines and token change process.

Oliver Reed: got the invites  thanks! One last thing: who captures roadmap meeting notes (cadence notes)?

Nora (PM): I capture the high-level decisions. PMs keep meeting minutes in the roadmap page under "Cadence notes"; designers can add design decisions there too. I can DM you the last three minutes.

Oliver Reed: please do, thatd help a lot. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :smile:
